Values are means with pointwise 95\% bootstrap confidence intervals below. $n$ denotes compounds evaluated by PCC, $\Delta$PCC and RMSE; $E$ requires matched references from other compounds and was evaluated on 3,915, 3,874 and 3,478 compounds at 2R, 3R and 4R, respectively. PCC, Pearson correlation coefficient computed on full profiles; $\Delta$PCC, Pearson correlation coefficient computed on control-subtracted responses; RMSE, root mean squared error; $E$, perturbation specificity (Fisher $z$). Res, residual prediction. $\uparrow$/$\downarrow$ indicate higher/lower is better. Bold marks the better mean within each setting. Target construction, seed aggregation and resampling are described in Methods.
